name: Pewpew Local HTTP Stress Tester
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local CLI for HTTP stress and fixed-rate benchmark testing; supports multiple targets, configurable concurrency, HTTP/2 and JSON/TSV exports; no software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: You supply the test machine, network capacity and target systems; load can disrupt services. No free hosted load generators, infrastructure or managed testing service is included. Use only against systems you are authorized to test.
